rubrics.question: Explain what happens during photosynthesis.
rubrics.reference_answer: Plants absorb light energy and take in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil, converting them into glucose and releasing oxygen as a by-product.

concepts.name: light energy
concepts.description: Light energy from the sun is absorbed by the plant

concepts.name: carbon dioxide intake
concepts.description: The plant takes in carbon dioxide from the air

concepts.name: glucose produced
concepts.description: Glucose (sugar) is produced as food for the plant

concepts.name: oxygen released
concepts.description: Oxygen is released as a by-product

rubrics.question: What is osmosis?
rubrics.reference_answer: Osmosis is the movement of water molecules across a partially permeable membrane from a dilute solution to a more concentrated solution.

concepts.name: dilute to concentrated
concepts.description: From a dilute solution to a more concentrated solution, down the water concentration gradient

rubrics.question: What is a primary key in a relational database?
rubrics.reference_answer: A primary key is a column or set of columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table; it cannot be NULL and is referenced by foreign keys to link tables.

concepts.name: uniquely identifies rows
concepts.description: Uniquely identifies each row or record in a table

concepts.name: cannot be null
concepts.description: Its value must always be present; it cannot be NULL

concepts.name: links tables via foreign keys
concepts.description: Other tables reference it through foreign keys to link tables

rubrics.question: What is overfitting in machine learning?
rubrics.reference_answer: Overfitting happens when a model is too complex and memorises the training data, including its noise, so it performs well on training data but poorly on new, unseen data.

concepts.name: fits training data too closely
concepts.description: The model memorises the training data including its noise

concepts.name: poor generalisation
concepts.description: It performs poorly on new, unseen data

concepts.name: model too complex
concepts.description: The model is too complex for the amount of data

rubrics.question: What does DNS do?
rubrics.reference_answer: DNS translates human-readable domain names into the numerical IP addresses that computers use to locate each other.

concepts.name: name resolution
concepts.description: Translates or resolves one thing into another, a lookup

concepts.name: IP addresses
concepts.description: Numerical IP addresses used by computers

rubrics.question: What is phishing?
rubrics.reference_answer: Phishing is a social-engineering attack in which an attacker impersonates a trusted organisation in an email or message to trick the victim into revealing sensitive information such as passwords or bank details.

concepts.name: impersonating a trusted source
concepts.description: The attacker pretends to be a trusted, legitimate organisation

concepts.name: stealing sensitive information
concepts.description: To trick the victim into revealing sensitive information like passwords or bank details

concepts.name: delivered by email or message
concepts.description: Delivered through an email, text message or malicious link
